prompt: Compared to cyclohexylamine (pKaH ~10.6), which amine is MOST BASIC?

options.label: N-methylcyclohexylamine (adds +I from methyl → slightly more basic)
Aniline (resonance delocalizes lone pair → MUCH less basic)
Diisopropylamine (very bulky — slightly less basic though has 2 alkyls)

explanation: Adding one alkyl group to N increases basicity in solution (inductive donation + solvation of RNH2 ⇌ R2NH about even). Nitro groups kill basicity (strongly EWG). Aryl amines are much less basic than aliphatic (resonance with ring).
